operation.description: No query parameters are read. Authenticated author only; deleted/missing post => 40401, another author => 42201. Empty final non-repost content without media, invalid visibility/language, invalid body/path, unusable attachments => 40001. Relationship arrays replace existing values when present; unknown keys and unsupported creation-only reference fields are ignored. Success data is complete serialized post, not a diff. Returning the updated post can also yield 40401 if it is no longer visible, or author lookup fails. Authentication accepts bearer token or access_token cookie according to auth middleware; all successful responses have meta=null (no pagination). Framework/Oracle/Redis failures can produce 5xx; source audit is not runtime acceptance.

AuditedCommunityJsonValue.description: Actual permissive JSON input accepted by coercion helpers; this is not an unspecified response object. Exact per-field normalization is documented on each input property.

AuditedCommunityErrorMetadata.description: V2 metadata attached to H3 createError.data; not the top-level HTTP error body.

stack.description: Development-only framework debugging information; representation differs between Nitro/H3 handlers.

AuditedCommunityHttpError.description: Framework-generated JSON error shell. Nitro production default includes error/url/statusCode/statusMessage/message and data for handled application errors. Sensitive/unhandled failures can omit data. Development can add stack. HTML error rendering is framework/content-negotiation dependent.

AuditedCommunityRelationship.description: v2RelationObject maps raw database relation to booleans; no closed enum is enforced on relation.

AuditedCommunityPublicUser.description: Complete v2MapPublicUser output, including presence fields omitted by the older V2PublicUser schema. Numeric fields use v2Number, not an asserted integer/0-or-1 schema. last_seen_at may retain an unparseable source string; no unconditional date-time format.

AuditedCommunityMedia.description: Complete v2MapMedia output. Media type/status are emitted database strings, without serializer enum validation. created_at falls back to an empty string.

AuditedCommunityPost.description: v2MapPost reads the visible feed item via fn_can_view_post. Dates can fall back to empty strings; location is always a string even when database value is null.

AuditedCommunityNotificationPreference.description: Always present fields. GET defaults enabled=true and updated_at=current ISO time when no row; PUT uses DB timestamp converted to string or empty string.

AuditedCommunityMemberRole.description: Requested target user id and accepted role, not proof that an existing row was updated.

AuditedCommunitySentimentConfig.description: No upstream request occurs. enabled uses configured flag; baseUrlConfigured reflects non-empty normalized config, including derived localhost default, not network reachability. timeout defaults to 10000 and clamps parsed positive input to 1000..120000.

content.description: Optional; strings preserved, numbers/booleans String-converted, null/arrays/objects become empty string. Omitted leaves existing content. No handler max length.

visibility.description: Optional exact case-sensitive enum. Omitted leaves current visibility.

language.description: Optional. v2String then trim/lowercase; empty defaults to zh. Non-empty normalized value must match /^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z0-9]{2,7})?$/; output limited to 10 characters.

location.description: Optional. v2String conversion; empty/null/non-scalar becomes database null, returned serializer emits empty string. Omitted unchanged.

media_ids.description: Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers or numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Deduplicate and keep first four; each must belong to caller and status uploaded/processing/ready. No rejection solely for >4 inputs.

tag_names.description: Optional replacement. Array items v2String-convert and trim, empty filtered; non-array becomes []. Strip one leading # then trim, deduplicate, first twenty retained.

mention_user_ids.description: Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers/numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Unique first fifty processed; missing users silently ignored.

mediaIds.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case media_ids is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers or numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Deduplicate and keep first four; each must belong to caller and status uploaded/processing/ready. No rejection solely for >4 inputs.

tagNames.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case tag_names is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items v2String-convert and trim, empty filtered; non-array becomes []. Strip one leading # then trim, deduplicate, first twenty retained.

mentionUserIds.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case mention_user_ids is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers/numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Unique first fifty processed; missing users silently ignored.

AuditedCommunityUpdatePostBody.description: JSON object required; every recognized field is optional, so {} is allowed. Unknown keys ignored. Omitted fields unchanged. This PUT performs a partial update. Non-repost final state must have non-blank content or at least one media id. Repost permits empty content/media.

is_enabled.description: Optional, defaults false when absent. true boolean, number exactly 1, or case-insensitive strings 1/true/yes map to true; all other JSON values map false. Strings are not trimmed. Examples: true, 1, "YES".

AuditedCommunityNotificationBody.description: JSON object required. Unknown keys ignored. {} disables notifications.

role.description: Required non-empty string after trim; case-sensitive enum after trimming. Whitespace around a valid value is accepted.

AuditedCommunityChangeRoleBody.description: Single role, despite plural URL alias. Unknown keys ignored. Owner cannot be assigned by this endpoint.
